story_type: spacewalk to replace a failed part
hook: A part failed on the space station. Two women went out to fix it.
narration: A part failed on the space station, so two astronauts went outside to replace it.
October eighteenth, twenty nineteen. NASA astronauts Christina Koch and Jessica Meir.
A battery charge unit on the station's truss had failed to switch on after an earlier spacewalk.
These boxes control how much charge goes into the batteries that power the station on every nighttime pass.
It was the first spacewalk ever conducted by two women.
[short pause] It was Meir's first, and she became the fifteenth woman to walk in space.
outcome: Koch and Meir changed out the faulty unit on the far end of the station's truss.
title: Two women sent out to fix a failed part
description:
On Oct. 18, 2019, NASA astronauts Christina Koch and Jessica Meir replaced a battery charge/discharge unit that had failed on the International Space Station's far port truss, during the first spacewalk ever conducted by two women.

facts.claim: Koch and Meir replaced a faulty component Oct. 18, first spacewalk by two women
facts.source_quote: Expedition 61 Flight Engineers Christina Koch and Jessica Meir of NASA replaced a faulty electrical component on the far port truss of the complex Oct. 18 during a spacewalk – the first ever conducted by two women.

facts.claim: A battery charge/discharge unit failed to activate after an earlier spacewalk
facts.source_quote: One of three battery charge/discharge units (BCDUs) on the P6 truss failed to activate late last week following the second in a series of spacewalks

facts.claim: The unit regulates charge into batteries that power the station during nighttime passes
facts.source_quote: Koch and Meir changed out the faulty unit that regulates the amount of charge put into the batteries that collect energy from the station’s solar arrays to power station systems during periods when the complex orbits during nighttime passes around the Earth.

facts.claim: Meir's first spacewalk; 15th woman to walk in space
facts.source_quote: the fourth for Koch and the first for Meir, who became the 15th female to walk in space.

visible_facts.claim: Spacewalkers on the truss and robotic arm above Earth, helmet camera views of the hardware
